name: Special Forces

narrative.details:
Now that many of his regular troops are reduced, you must face his highly trained forces.  When they're not in the wilderness slaughtering our rebel soldiers, they are found deep in the back of the Kurzen Compound, in a cave they call the Stockpile.

I know many of Kurzen's troops personally, and I know they are skilled, loyal, and cruel.  This is no easy task I set before you, adventurer.

After you defeat them, report to Lieutenant Doren, my commanding officer.  He will want your report firsthand.
narrative.objectives:
Kill 10 Kurzen Commandoes and 6 Kurzen Headshrinkers.

Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
adventurer. Sergeant Yohwa trusted your abilities, and I trust her. The defeat you brought to Kurzen's forces is almost too much to hope for. I had feared we rebels were alone, and alone we could never stand up against the Colonel's brilliance.

Perhaps hope of our survival yet remains.
narrative.requestItemsText: Sergeant Yohwa tells me you are skilled and brave, Champion. Do you have something to report?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 33 to 46, 13,000 XP in all.

quests.name: The Second Rebellion
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters. Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Special Forces
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kurzen Commandoes and 6 Kurzen Headshrinkers. Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Colonel Kurzen
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Mai'Zoth
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
